errors.recordedInFuture: That date is in the future. Pick today or earlier.
errors.recordedBeforePrevious: This entry has to stay the latest one. Pick a date after the previous entry.
errors.entryNotLatest: Only the latest entry can be edited. Add a new one with the right amount.
errors.entryNotManual: A transfer made this entry. Edit the transfer instead.
errors.transferNotLatest: Balances have moved since this transfer. Make a correcting transfer instead.
errors.transferBackdated: One of the accounts already has a later balance. Give the transfer a later date.
errors.accountHasHistory: This account already has entries. Its currency cannot change now.
errors.accountHasTransfers: This account has transfers. You can only archive it.
errors.accountsImmutable: A transfer keeps its accounts. Delete it and make a new one.
errors.amountReceivedRequired: Say how much arrived on the other account.
errors.transferInvalid: That transfer will not work. Check the accounts and the amounts.
errors.receivedInFuture: That date is in the future. Use today or earlier.
errors.creditNotLatest: This account already has a later balance. Record the inflow without an account and update the balance by hand.
errors.inflowNotLatest: The account's balance has changed since this inflow. Only the most recent one can be edited.
errors.creditedAmountRequired: The currencies differ. Enter how much reached the account.
errors.creditedMismatch: Same currency, so the account received the same amount. Remove the second number.
errors.nonPositiveAmount: The amount has to be more than zero.
errors.creditedWithoutAccount: There's a credited amount but no account. Pick an account or clear the amount.
errors.activePeriodInvalid: The end date is before the start date.
errors.payDaysInvalid: Pay days are numbers from 1 to 31, each once.
errors.rateOutOfRange: Tax and commission go from 0 to 99.99%.
errors.sourceHasInflows: This source already has inflows. You can end it, but not delete it or change its currency.
errors.defaultAccountNotFound: The default account wasn't found. Pick another one.
errors.accountHasInflows: Inflows were credited to this account. It can only be archived.
errors.billingMonthRequiresYearly: Only a yearly expense has a billing month

offline.saved: Saved on this device. It will be sent when you are back online.

route.failed: This screen did not load. An update has most likely shipped.
